notes.title: Version EA 3.30
notes.content:
[b][u]You CAN'T play old save files with this version.[/u][/b]

WARNING: New improvements in this update may cause new errors. I will try to fix any errors you have reported as soon as possible. Thanks in advance for your help.

The main character weapon holding animations do not work for now, and the character type does not change when you select a prebuilded character. These errors will be fixed in the next update.

[List]
[*]Unity version updated to 2019.1.11f1
[*]Now the player character can be selected from all NPC models
[*]Added prebuilded character selection option

[*]The key configuration for the controller can be changed

[*]Gaining full trust or love from an NPC or completing NPC quests now gives Karma

[*]Fast weapon replacement menu locks character if there is no weapon in inventory - Fixed
[*]No upgrade option available when Q menu is open
[*]Manhole covers and airplane drops names are "ss"

[*]No droplets appear in the sewer
[*]When you select Free mode and go back, new game problems arise
[*]In some cases, the carried object can be thrown continuously
[*]Drinking dirty water does not increase the rate of dirtiness
[*]Stacks ignored when collecting science points
[*]Unable to remove falling doors

notes.title: Version EA 3.20
notes.content:
[b][u]You CAN'T play old save files with this version.[/u][/b]

At last... I'm sorry for this update took a long time. Changes and tests of several systems in the game caused this. (The problems in my private life also affected, but this is not an excuse, of course).

For now, home improvements have been deactivated. The next update will be activate again.

New bugs may occur due to new systems. I'll try to fix them as much as I can, by taking screen shots of bugs or sending messages. Good games to everyone in advance.

notes.title: About New Update
notes.content:
Hello to everyone. 1.5 months passed since last update. There are those who think I've stopped developing the game, but that's not true. On the contrary, I am working on the next update.

[h1][b]In the next update[/b][/h1]

[h1]Zombie Mode[/h1] 
You can play as a zombie in this mode and when you died with zombification, you can continue game play as a zombie. This mode only for fun not any game ending there unless you die.

[h1]Graphical improvement[/h1]
Not much but you will see the differences.

[h1]Mini Games[/h1]
Already added some of mini games and future updates I will add more of them. A kind of monopoly with different rules, tetris, card game, mangala and some small games were added.

[h1]Industrial area[/h1]
A small industrial area added at ASABUY. Lots of materials and vehicles you can find in there. a large industrial area will be added in the future at near Kiyikent. 

[h1]New sounds[/h1]
Lots of objects now have their own open and close sound.

[h1]Animals[/h1]
I am started to working on animals. But for now I will only add chicken for testing purposes. In future updates animal type to be increased.



These are just biggest improvement. More improvement will come along with next update (New melee combat system, new objects ect). But you have to wait a little more for it. It will be upload in this month if there is no problem occurs. Thanks for your support.

Mehan Games

notes.title: Version EA 3.00
notes.content:
[b][u]You CAN'T play old save files with this version. Base for coop system and base for animals datas, corrupt old save files. Sorry for that happening. [/u][/b]

Hello everyone. One month past since last update. But this one contains very good features.

In this update I worked mostly on the Coop system and added base codes for coop. (Host server, connect server, motion and animation syncs completed.)

You can see some errors at starting at game, just wait a little. Then game will begun.

I suggest for delete the file at "My Documents/Stay Alive Apocalypse/Ayarlar.xml" then make your settings again when start the game.

[*]NPCs can tell lived events with gossip among themselves.

notes.title: Version EA 2.05
notes.content:
[b][u]You can play old save files with this version. (after version EA 2.00) [/u][/b]

Hello. How are you? Three weeks have passed since the last update. I know, it took more than usual. It took a long time to set up the new systems as well as some problems with my computer that caused it to lengthen.

I hope it was worth updating.

I encourage you to play a new game so that all changes and innovations in this update work in the most efficient way. Innovations in old records may not have an effect.

[b][u]Main Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Vehicle upgrades added. (Trucks and motorbike can't upgradable yet)

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Araba.png] Picture [/url]
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/AileArabasi.png] Picture [/url] 
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Kamyonet.png] Picture [/url]
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Jip.1.png] Picture [/url]
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Minibus.png] Picture [/url]
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Otobus.png] Picture [/url] 

[*]Steel and Coal raw materials added to the game. They can be produced, also can be found from the dumps, as well as from the construction sites.
[*]Biofuel Production Machine, Coal Production Stove, Steel Production Stove, Paint Box Machine, Canned Food Machine and Chips Machine were added to the game.

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/BiofuelKomurCelik.png] Picture [/url]
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/CipsKonserveBoya.png] Picture [/url]

[*]Paint box and empty paint box added to the game. They are used for painting to vehicles.
[*]"Statistics" button added to the game main screen

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Istatistik.png] Picture [/url]

[*]Added missing parts of vehicles can be rebuilt
[/list]

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Vehicle hud indicator changed

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/AracHud4.png] Picture [/url]
[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/AracHud5.png] Picture [/url]

[*]Spoiling food loses its bonuses and the raise tje chances of getting sick
[*]The cause of death is displayed on the screen after died
[*]You will get an information when an NPC died (only in your groups)
[*]NPCs can removing objects from their way
[*]NPCs are taken out of the way of other NPCs
[*]It also says how many must be done during task information
[*]There were 2 "Get rid of the zombie virus" in the centrifuge screen. One was changed to "Increase Health Limit". So you can increase your Health up to a maximum of 150

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Santrifuj.png] Picture [/url]

[*]Metal materials updated
[*]The burning values of the production materials are written in the information section
[*]JKLMB keys allow you to exit from the same screen
[*]If production and special talent books are already known, they are written on the screen
[*]Objects stack count also display when you look at it
[*]The CASUT effects of liquids in containers can now be seen without taking inventory
[*]Unsaved files are deleted when they are clicked on the Load Game screen
[*]Added "Autofill" option for cabinets

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Envanter.1.png] Picture [/url]

(Reminder: Those who own a carpentry trait can produce pockets and can add containers to furnitures)
[/list]

[b][u]Changes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Zombie disease is now active when the pollution is 100%. (wearing viral clothing or infected food directly affects zombification)
[*]Reduced likelihood of random aid box planes from 10% to 3%
[*]The condition of the energy storages decreasing when charging (so that you can not use it forever)
[*]Object building or placement distances reduced
[*]Reduced chance of finding object from zombies from 50% to 10% for each pocket
[*]The amount of gas in the upgraded oven can be seen
[*]Headshot damage reduced from x10 to x2
[*]"Listed Keys" setting moved to "Control Settings"
[*]If the bonus features on the clothes are bad for the character they are written red
[*]The aging rate of the objects to be worn is increased and the broken object is given notification
[*]The power of the nail gun is reduced
[*]Reduced punching speed
[*]Some flame effects updated

[url=http://media.indiedb.com/images/members/5/4008/4007526/profile/Alev.png] Picture [/url]

[*]High Quality Rain effect updated
[*]Reduced requirements to produce centrifuges
[*]Key info display screen updated
[*]All items with cabinets that can not be taken into inventory can be named without pen
[*]The area is marked safe when shelter selected
[*]F3 key closes the hud screen (to take a screenshot)
[*]The worker now starts with 10 scrap metal, 10 copper wires and 2 gears (increased by 2 times)
[*]E key operations are also listed in listed keys
[*]Height drop threshold increased by 2 times
[*]The duration of the become free from leader or spouse was increased to 5 days
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Vehicles do not save objects placed on battery, engine, petrol store or truck bed
[*]An object with a cover is not broken apart
[*]While adding objects with the "Shift" key from cabinet to inventory, the screen freezes if inventory is full
[*]When saving for the first time, clicking on the name of the save game deletes the save file
[*]Suction pressure pump no name
[*]NPCs do not drink water unless water is cut
[*]Negative features of rotting food are turning positive
[*]Foods with negative effects on thirst are filling the toilet needs
[*]The ambulance has LOD problems
[*]Pool areas are not spawning
[*]Color change problem with tool table
[*]NPCs walk out as first job
[*]NPCs and Zombies are slowly falling
[*]Vehicle torque is not enough to accelerate the car
[*]NPCs own apartments
[*]The background colors that determine the types of objects in inventory and cabinet are different
[*]When it comes to "Craft Heater" task in Build Shelter Task, the schematic of the heater is not learned
[*]When the objects thrown then carry later, some of the objects are disappearing
[*]Shopping cart LOD level color incompatibility
[*]Can be passed through the garage door at manor
[*]Secure zones are not active until you sleep when you open a saved game
[*]Splint object type problem (causing screen freeze when placing)
[*]When the natural gas is cut off, gas cannisters can't burn
[*]The burrito collider area is very small
[*]All the jeeps are spawned without hood
[*]Virtual doors and windows can be open while completing the missing parts of the rooms
[*]NPCs are teleporting to the top or to the roof while they are standing up
[*]The fireplace disappears after loading
[*]RAT can not be run
[*]It's not raining outside the city
[*]Door spikes disappear after loading (but the effect continues)
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes (Need more testing to be sure)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Get damage when get out the vehicle
[*]Vehicles can not go uphill (engine power is regulated, will still have problems when going up slowly)
[*]Door spikes can not be added to the upgraded doors
[*]Hospital entrance and operating room are empty
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Spouse or leadership status abort threshold has been raised but If the the same problem persists, please let me know
[*]NPCs can get stuck in furniture when they stand up
[*]Large gas canister's Cylinder Cooker disappear after loading
[*]When the bus front glass is upgraded, the screen freezes (it is fixed by ESC, but can not be upgraded)
[*]The description of the "Raise Health" in the centrifuge is wrong
[*]NPCs can not find the way to the apartment shops
[*]Mouse cursor not visible after go back main screen
[/list]

In the next update, I plan to change the NPC models if there is no problem. I also want to use a different voice for each NPC.

You can still send your voicings if you want your voicings to be added to the NPCs. Detailed information can be found on the link below.

http://steamcommunity.com/games/622420/announcements/detail/3025727250375175761

[b][u]I would recommend you to use a new name when opening a new game.[/u][/b]

[*]In the inventory, you can also operate with the right button in the open cabinet

[*]The weight of the objects loaded in the vehicle affects the weight of the vehicle now
[*]Added suction plunger at villages. Works as an unlimited water source (not tested)
[*]You can give flowers to NPCs (Also Valentine's Day Special)
[/list]

[*]Reduced chance of get depression
[*]"Connect" key image changed
[*]Water consumption rate of crops decreased by 5 times
[*]Reduced chance of finding weapons from zombies
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]To consume and finish the liquid object is corrupt save files - Fixed
[*]The skull in the museum is corrupt the save files - Fixed

[*]Zombies do not hit barricades - Fixed
[*]Can not climb vertical stairs - Fixed
[*]Sometimes the vehicle can not go forward or backward - Fixed
[*]Vehicles stuck after hitting a zombie - Fixed
[*]The displaced object still shows the number of stack in the inventory - Fixed
[*]When an object destroyed, inside objects destroyed too - Fixed
[*]Ground collision problem in some buildings - Fixed
[*]All trucks glass and doors are upgraded after loading a game - Fixed
[*]Panelvan converted to minibus after loading - Fixed
[*]Sewing table converted into garment cabinet after loading - Fixed
[*]structures can be break at villages - Fixed
[*]Portable bed pivot point problem - Fixed
[*]Missing window in village house - Fixed
[*]Some minor bugs for breaking objects - Fixed
[*]Not water in the water reservoirs - Fixed
[*]The right mouse button can not be hit a mark on the terrains - Fixed
[*]Vehicles are not damaged from explosions - Fixed
[*]Exploding vehicle lamps remain on - Fixed
[*]The appearance of the produced dining table as a centrifuge - Fixed
[*]In some cities objects left on roads are not saved - Fixed
[/list]

[b][u]Fixes (Need more testing to be sure)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]The water in the pools disappears after loading and the water does not appear. (It is also necessary to plug the pools now for filling.) - Fixed
[*]Vehicle tire can not be changed - Fixed
[*]The "development" tasks received from the leader are not audited - Fixed
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Video Camera not connected to generator
[*]Exploded vehicles appear normal after loading
[*]There is no lifting jacket inventory picture
[/list]

[*]You can craft an engine with sports belt, belt or sweat band instead of leather belt.
[*]On the pick locking screen, the wire speed is accelerated 2.5 times.
[*]Drone voice changed.

[*]Crouch and get up speed increased

notes.title: Version EA 1.05
notes.content:
[b][u]You can play old save files with this version. (after version EA 1.03)[/u][/b] 

[b][u]I would recommend you to use a new name when opening a new game.[/u][/b] 

[b][u]Features [/u][/b] 
[list]
[*]Newly added crafting objects:
Bookcase, Armchair, Table, Chair, Stool, Bed, Toilet, Fridge, Shower Cabin, Multi Chest, Steep Stairs, Horizontal Stairs, Window Wall
[*]"Dart" was added as a new bullet type. (The dart gun will be added later)
[*]If the objects carried by "E" are now place on an object with pockets, they are put directly into it, not onto it. For example; you can carry the engine and place it in the directly vehicle block.
(Note1: this happens if there is empty pocket and the pocket is large enough to get the object)
[*]The number of physics calculations has been added to the "Gameplay settings". Changes were made to the physics system.
[*]Sewerage was added to KIYIKENT. (Only one city has been added since it is in the testing process and will be added to other cities over time)
[*]You can construct crafting objects that are not in the inventory by clicking on the "Wrench" button.
[*]You can remove zombification progress with science points which earn with autopsies and centrifugal.
[*]Added the ability to rotate other directions while placing weapons. (You can rotate it in the x axis by pressing and holding the left shift key. You can rotate it in the z axis by pressing and holding the left alt key)
[/list]

[b][u]Changes[/u][/b] [list]
[*]The tree fire effect on the first screen menu has been changed.
[*]NPC commands are assigned to Numpad keys.
[*]Updated high quality rain effect.
[*]If there is no soil in the arable objects, the indicators will no longer shown.
[*]Barrels weight were reduced from 100 kilograms to 10 kilograms. (It will effect on newly created objects)
[*]Tutorial translation errors have been fixed (thanks to BigGreen21)
[*]The water effect of the shower was changed
[*]Changes were made in vehicle dynamics. (Sudden turns cause you to topple. I will still work on it.) I advise you to stop the engine before you get out the car.[/list]

[b][u]Fixes[/u][/b] [list]
[*]CASUT indicators on foods are green even when under zero - Fixed
[*]The problem that the number of zombies does not change with difficulty - Fixed
[*]The apartments look empty - Fixed
[*]Herbs from the ground in the houses of GUZELDAG - Fixed
[*]Kitchen glass in an apartment be shrunk after the saved game is opened - Fixed
[*]Problems to turn on the refrigerator - Fixed
[*]Screen shift problem in settings - Fixed
[*]The problem is that first aid supplies pass directly to the disease instead of lowering it - Fixed
[*]The issue of coming as a male although the female character is selected - Fixed
[*]Burning cars spawn in the air - Fixed
[*]The problem of can't construct barrel - Fixed
[*]The tandoor is invisible. Tandoor or fireplace can't turn on with matches problem - Fixed
[*]The problem of the turn on of the oven affecting the operation of other objects - Fixed
[*]Evapowater water fullness fault (also added working sound) - Fixed
[*]Refrigerators spawning in the air in the restaurant - Fixed[/list]

[b][u]Fixes (Need more testing to be sure)[/u][/b] [list]
[*]Half of the materials given in the indicator are sufficient when reconstruct windows or doors - Fixed
[*]NPCs enter looping in mansion and villa garden - Fixed
[*]Police character can not craft bullets - Fixed
[*]Sound not cut off when generator is switched off - Fixed
[*]The problem of not getting anything from the house of the newly added NPC - Fixed[/list]

[b][u]HOT FİX:[/u][/b][list]
[*]Added to the angulardrag to vehicles. (Not tested)
[*]Upgraded glass looks normal after load game
[*]Small trash can change color
[*]Numbers not updated when stack obcjets
[*]Only the most recent ability is used if an objects have multiple ability.
[*]Portable bed comfort is zero
[*]The objects disappear when you place multiple objects at the same time in a contailer.
[*]When you put the object into the contailer, the sound comes now.
[*]Darts can launch with Q (for now throwing side)
[*]Objects in the Toolbox disappear when placing.[/list]
